title: A Big Mac Now Costs Less Work Than in 1990
sentence: At the average US hourly wage, a Big Mac took 13 minutes of work in April 1990 ($2.20 at $10.12 an hour) and 11.5 minutes in July 2026 ($6.22 at $32.42 an hour); the cheapest point was 2001, at about 9.3 minutes.
source: The Economist, Big Mac index data (US price, April 1990 to July 2026): https://github.com/TheEconomist/big-mac-data

US Bureau of Labor Statistics, average hourly earnings of production and nonsupervisory employees, total private (CES0500000008, seasonally adjusted), via FRED: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/AHETPI
